Name: Appleseed's Lab-Grown Meat (For Animal Husbandry Mod)
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/Gc7jhyt.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/KhFhK6s.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
This mod adds two new machines: The [color=#e69138][b]Genetic Decoder[/b][/color] and [color=#e69138][b]Cell Garden[/b][/color]. Both recipes are simultaneously sent in a letter with configurable trigger conditions.[/size]

[size=3]Genetic Decoders[/size][size=3] convert an animal product into the sequenced[color=#e69138] [b]DNA[/b] [/color]of that respective animal, a new "category" of items. DNA can be put into Cell Gardens to "clone" the animal's tissue, producing meat without having to erase your livestock! Deluxe and large items yield more DNA.

Certain bone artifacts produce [b][color=#e69138]Terrestrial[/color][/b] and [b][color=#e69138]Marine[/color][/b] DNA. Putting these into a Cell Garden results in random meat from Terrestrial DNA and random roe from Marine DNA, and other additional items if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] is installed.

[size=3]The aesthetic of the [/size]machines ﻿and DNA[/size][size=3] can be switched between high-tech or low-tech/magical (See the Configuration section.)[/size]


[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/KvqYQMJ.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
This mod also adds Dinosaur meat and three Dinosaur-based cooking recipes! It's produced by sequencing Dinosaur DNA from Dinosaur eggs -- the ability to butcher/exchange Dinosaurs is not currently included.

The meat sprite has two variants to either fit more with the vanilla art style or retextures such as[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35058] ZoeyHoshi's[/url].[/size]


[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/Yqxiwxx.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=3][b][color=#e69138]Medieval Mode[/color][/b] (Default False): Toggle the look and flavor text of machines and DNA, whether Maru or the Wizard sends you the machines' crafting recipes, and what items are needed to craft the machines. Made to compliment mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26192]Witchy Craftables[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Medieval Craftables[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743?tab=files&file_id=144388]Alchemistry[/url].

[b][color=#e69138]Lock Machine Recipes[/color][/b] (Default True): Choose to either be sent the machine recipes instantly, or only after building a Deluxe Barn.

[b][color=#e69138]Dinosaur Meat [/color][/b](Default True): Enable or disable Dinosaur meat and cooking.

[b][color=#e69138]Dinosaur Meat Sprite[/color][/b] (Default Default): Choose between a detailed or simpler look, with the detailed sprite being the default.[/size]



[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/IYCkyGp.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
[size=3]Lab-Grown Meat has built-in compatibility with several other livestock mods! See this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4371]Article[/url] for details.[/size][/size]
[center]﻿[/center]
